messages.subject: poppr::info_table with recoded data
messages.body_plain:
Since the info_table function is pretty valid for displaying ploidy I've tried to use it with recoded data with the following commands

data(Pinf)

iPinf <- recode_polyploids(Pinf)

info_table(iPinf, type = "ploidy", plot = TRUE, low = "black", high = "orange")

this will produce the following error:

Error: test_zeroes(x) is not TRUE

How to fix this?

The fact that I'm using ploidy analysis with recoded data is because the original data will present zeros that are not real allele information but missing information.

Many thanks for who can help me.

Federico
